posts.title: Didn't Know
posts.description: He set me down quietly and didn't tell me. I didn't know that. I kept walking toward a hand that wasn't reaching back anymore, because I trusted. Completely. I thought I was safe. posts.title: My A-cuteness is Chronic But My Brain is Ironic 🖤
posts.description: Today I realized that I still grapple with outdated programming about my mental illnesses. In particular, cPTSD, PTSD, and Major Depressive Disorder. Specifically, the outdated perspective is that these conditions are not "real" or "worthy" of so much fuss. They are less valid than physical or "real" medical conditions. You just need to go dig deep, access willpower, and do some positive thinking!
